fields.caption: New study proves that drinking 5 liters of lemon water a day cures all ailments! Doctors are hiding this from you.
fields.ground_truth_explanation: This is a well-known health myth. While hydration is important, lemon water does not cure all ailments and excessive water intake can be dangerous.
fields.primary_verification_signal: No credible medical sources or scientific studies support this claim. Cross-referencing reveals it as a common debunked myth.
